project.name: Pronto
project.identity: A local-first macOS command center for understanding and safely coordinating a portfolio of Git repositories and agent workspaces.
project.audience: Developers and repository operators managing multiple local codebases, worktrees, quality signals, and release-preparation workflows.
project.core_loop: Register repository roots, refresh evidence, inspect ranked conditions and remediation, take a separately authorized action, then refresh to verify the resulting state.
project.north_star: A user can trust Pronto to show current repository truth and the next safe action without silently modifying source, Git history, provider state, or releases.
not_this: An AI system that makes operational decisions by default

mvp.definition: A dependable macOS desktop and CLI command center that turns current local Git, workspace, quality, and freshness evidence into a clear safe next action without modifying repositories.

complete_product.definition: A trustworthy portfolio operating surface that adds read-only provider, pull-request, and release-preparation context plus governed operational handoffs while preserving explicit authorization and evidence boundaries.

outcomes.name: The user can discover repositories and worktrees into a durable, local portfolio snapshot.

layers.intended: Local repository evidence remains useful without an account, network access, or operational authority.
layers.planned: The accepted architecture uses a Tauri and Rust core, SQLite persistence, and shared renderer and CLI contracts.
layers.implemented: The core registers roots, discovers repositories and linked worktrees, scans Git state, and persists versioned SQLite snapshots.
layers.verified: Rust and renderer tests pass, the installed bundle matches the current release build, and a provider-native macOS interaction opened the live Pronto repository detail with current portfolio, Compass, quality, workspace, condition, branch, and analytics evidence.

outcomes.name: The user can distinguish configured ideals from fresh passing quality, CI, finding, and maturity evidence.

layers.intended: Missing, stale, failed, blocked, or unavailable evidence never appears as passing, and raw detector findings remain distinguishable from reviewed actionable work.
layers.planned: Pronto consumes Quality Runner maturity and gate evidence read-only, preserves provenance and freshness, and reconciles repository-owned finding dispositions by stable fingerprint.
layers.implemented: Quality projections expose configured, covered, fresh passing, missing, stale, failed, and blocked gates plus raw findings, reviewed dispositions, actionable totals, and maturity. Remediation excludes only current non-actionable dispositions and fails open when the ledger is missing, invalid, expired, or unreconcilable.
